# cosmonexus

> Monorepo for @cosmonexus packages: design tokens, reactive primitives, dual-framework UI components, and an editor framework.

## Repository Structure

This is a Bun workspace monorepo with Moon as the task runner. All packages are TypeScript with strict mode, built with tsup (ESM + CJS + DTS output), linted with Biome, and tested with Vitest.

## Packages

### @cosmonexus/design-tokens
Framework-agnostic design token package using vanilla-extract.
- `tokens` — createThemeContract with semantic slots (colors, fonts, spacing, radius, shadows, transitions)
- `darkTheme` — OKLCH dark theme implementation (teal/cyan accent at hue 175)
- Global CSS reset and base typography
- Import: `import { tokens } from '@cosmonexus/design-tokens/contract'`
- Import: `import { darkTheme } from '@cosmonexus/design-tokens/themes/dark'`

### @cosmonexus/nova-types
TypeScript type definitions for the reactive system. No runtime code.
- `Signal<T>` — [getter, setter] tuple type
- `Subscriber` — reactive subscription with dependencies and execute()
- `Dependency` — Set<Subscriber> tracking a signal's subscribers
- `Subscribable<T>` / `Unsubscribable` — observable subscription interface
- `UnwrapObservable`, `UnwrapObservableLookup`, `UnwrapObservableTuple` — type-level unwrapping
- `Dict<T>`, `RequiredBy<T, K>` — utility types
- `Direction`, `Orientation`, `CommonProperties`, `PropTypes` — UI types

### @cosmonexus/nova-store
Reactive primitives + RxJS-based state container.
- `createSignal<T>(value)` — creates a reactive [getter, setter] with auto-tracking
- `createEffect(fn)` — auto-subscribing side effect that re-runs on signal changes
- `createMemo<T>(fn)` — derived reactive computation
- `cleanup(subscriber)` — removes subscriber from all tracked dependencies
- `Store<T>` class — RxJS BehaviorSubject-based store with dispatch/select/subscribe
- Dependencies: @cosmonexus/nova-types, rxjs (peer)

### @cosmonexus/nova-react
React hooks and providers binding to nova-store.
- `useTheme<T>()` — access theme from ThemeProvider context
- `ThemeProvider` — provides theme object via context
- `useObservable<T>(obs$)` — subscribes to RxJS Observable, returns latest value
- `useSubscribe<T>(obs$, callback)` — subscribes for side effects only
- `useSnapshot<T>(options)` — BehaviorSubject-backed state with observable stream
- `createStateMachine()` — linear state machine (INITIAL→SETUP→RUNNING→DONE)
- `useSafeLayoutEffect` — SSR-safe useLayoutEffect
- Dependencies: @cosmonexus/nova-store, @cosmonexus/nova-types, react (peer), rxjs (peer)

### @cosmonexus/nova-ui
React component library styled with vanilla-extract recipes.
- `Button` — primary/secondary variants, default/small sizes, loading, fullWidth, disabled
- `Input` — label, error state with aria-invalid, forwarded HTML attributes
- `Alert` — success/error/warning with ARIA roles (role="alert" or role="status")
- `StatusChip` — created/accessed/modified/deleted semantic pills
- `Pagination` — page numbers, prev/next, ellipsis, keyboard accessible
- `Card` — surface2 container with optional title
- `DataTable<T>` — generic typed columns, loading skeleton, empty state, row click + keyboard
- `Skeleton` — shimmer animation, text/row variants
- Dependencies: @cosmonexus/design-tokens, react (peer), @vanilla-extract/css (peer), @vanilla-extract/recipes (peer)

### @cosmonexus/nova-ui-solid
Solid.js component library — same components and APIs as nova-ui but for Solid.
- Same 8 components as nova-ui (Button, Input, Alert, StatusChip, Pagination, Card, DataTable, Skeleton)
- Uses Solid patterns: splitProps, Accessor<T>, Show, For, createUniqueId
- Dependencies: @cosmonexus/design-tokens, solid-js (peer), @vanilla-extract/css (peer), @vanilla-extract/recipes (peer)

### @cosmonexus/cm
CodeMirror 6 wrapper package with sub-path exports.
- `@cosmonexus/cm/core` — re-exports from `codemirror`
- `@cosmonexus/cm/state` — re-exports from `@codemirror/state`
- `@cosmonexus/cm/view` — re-exports from `@codemirror/view`
- `@cosmonexus/cm/language` — re-exports from `@codemirror/language`
- `@cosmonexus/cm/lint` — re-exports from `@codemirror/lint`
- `@cosmonexus/cm/langpack` — re-exports from `@codemirror/legacy-modes/mode/yaml`

### @cosmonexus/stellate
Editor extension framework built on CodeMirror.
- `Editor` — wraps EditorView with high-level API (getContent, setContent, destroy)
- `Extension<Options>` — base class for plugins, override extension() to provide CodeMirror extensions
- `ExtensionManager` — registry for managing extensions by name
- `EventEmitter<T>` — type-safe event system (on, off, emit)
- Dependencies: @cosmonexus/cm

### @cosmonexus/tsconfig
Shared TypeScript configuration files.
- `base.json` — strict, ES2022, bundler moduleResolution, verbatimModuleSyntax
- `library.json` — extends base, adds composite
- `app.json` — extends base, adds jsx: "react-jsx", noEmit

## Design Token Architecture

Three-layer system:
1. **Open Props** — CSS custom properties providing raw primitive values (imported globally)
2. **Theme Contract** (`tokens`) — semantic slots defined via `createThemeContract`
3. **Theme Implementation** (`darkTheme`) — maps contract slots to concrete OKLCH values

Components only reference the contract (`tokens.color.accent1`, `tokens.space[4]`, etc.), never raw values. Themes can be swapped by applying a different class.

## Key Conventions

- All colors use OKLCH for perceptual uniformity
- Spacing scale: 0.25rem increments (space.1=0.25rem through space.10=2.5rem)
- Focus visible: all interactive elements use `tokens.focusRing` box-shadow
- Accessibility: WCAG 2.2 AA contrast, ARIA roles on all dynamic widgets
- Components export both the component and its props type
- vanilla-extract `recipe()` for variant-based components, `style()` for single-variant

## File Patterns

- Library packages: `packages/<name>/src/index.ts` (barrel), `tsup.config.ts`, `tsconfig.json`, `moon.yml`
- Component packages: `packages/<name>/src/<ComponentName>/<ComponentName>.tsx` + `<ComponentName>.css.ts`
- Build output: `packages/<name>/dist/` (ESM .js, CJS .cjs, DTS .d.ts)
- Config: `.moon/workspace.yml`, `.moon/toolchain.yml`, `biome.json`, `vitest.workspace.ts`

## Commands

- `bun install` — install all workspace dependencies
- `bun run build` — build all packages via Moon (topological order)
- `bun run lint` — lint with Biome
- `bun run format` — format with Biome
- `bun run typecheck` — type check all packages
- `bun run test` — run all tests via Moon
